facts.anchor: I didn’t see Zak the next day, but he texted:
facts.fact: Zak 说嫂子的侄女流鼻血不止，Zara 与 Kyle 医院守夜，他与父亲留宿看两个男孩。

facts.anchor: If anyone comes to the store [laughter emoji], tell them we’ll be back tomorrow. Specialist with Dad.
facts.fact: Meg 注意到自己「想他但不愿承认」，转而复盘 Georgia 那句「没有正确答案」。

facts.anchor: I almost tagged his message with a heart but wondered if that was too Valentine-y after our kiss. Instead, I texted back:
facts.fact: 她反省自己的接线式思维：他不承诺，我也不承诺；不承诺干脆别开始。

facts.anchor: If anyone comes to your store, I’ll poach them the way I always do.
facts.fact: 她忆起自己当妈与照顾病父时练出的临场调整能力（adjustments on the fly）。

facts.anchor: His response took long enough that I started to wonder if I’d been too flippant—especially considering he was still reeling from what had happened with Dale yesterday.
facts.fact: 真正让她不安的是另一件事：她开始 Really, really 喜欢 Zak。

facts.anchor: I don’t want a war, but I can compete if I have to.
facts.fact: 她给 Zak 发短信问「还有空一起吃午饭吗」，同时打算给母亲与朋友写欢迎信。

facts.anchor: He added a photo of something that looked like an old-fashioned egg-beater but with a phallus instead of beaters.
